name: screen_capture
description: Capture the current iPhone screen as a compressed image for visual inspection. Only available after the user enables AI screen control. The image is sent to the selected AI provider.

name: screen_tap
description: Tap the iPhone screen at normalized coordinates from 0 to 1. Capture the screen first and verify the target.

name: screen_swipe
description: Swipe from normalized start coordinates to normalized end coordinates over 0.1 to 2 seconds.

name: screen_type
description: Paste 1 to 2000 Unicode characters, including Chinese, into the focused text field. Set replace=true when replacing an existing search query. Does not press Search/Return. Inspect and handle Allow Paste if shown, then verify text. Never type credentials or private codes.

replace.description: Select all existing contents before pasting, for replacing a search query or text.

name: screen_home
description: Press the iPhone Home action to leave the current app or show the Home screen.
